summary: Nutex Health filed an 8-K furnishing a press release updating a previously disclosed cybersecurity incident. The unauthorized third party published allegedly obtained data on its website; Nutex, with third-party forensics and advisors, is downloading and analyzing the data to determine contents, scope and authenticity, a process expected to take several weeks. No material impact on operations or financial reporting systems has been identified to date. No transaction, securities offering, or special-situation event is involved; this is a routine current report on an operational matter, not a deal.
